primary_goal: Map MACE-MH-1 errors across ZrC temperature and volume, then measure data-efficient repair using DFT labels
first_stage_deliverables: Traceable 64-atom candidate configurations across selected state points
10-20 diverse development configurations for DFT protocol calibration
Initial E/F/stress error assessment after DFT results return

model.name: MACE-MH-1
model.head: omat_pbe
model.precision_check: Compare float32/float64 static E/F/stress and NVE drift before production sampling

structure.volume_extension_rule: Extend high-temperature scan if mean pressures show the requested pressure region is not covered; retain actual volume and pressure for every state
structure.reference_update_rule: When DFT a0 is available, create a new reference/manifest version; never relabel existing frames as if their cells had changed

state_points.phase_label_rule: Do not infer solid or liquid from thermostat temperature; combine partial RDF, crystalline order and species-resolved unwrapped MSD
state_points.cooling_branch: Add independently tracked cooling paths only after a disordered/liquid-like state is evidenced; preserve heating/cooling lineage

md.equilibration_rule: Inspect stationarity and block statistics of temperature, potential energy, pressure and structure; assigned duration alone does not establish equilibrium

nve_check.decision: Require finite values and no unexplained secular drift; inspect drift, oscillation amplitude and time-step/precision dependence; marginal cases need longer checks

md.early_stop: Stop on nonfinite values or sustained explosive heating/forces; retain the last finite frames. Element-pair short-distance and force alarms must be calibrated from reference data, not used as unverified physics cutoffs.

analysis.rdf_maximum_radius_rule: Less than half the shortest box length; compare different sizes over a common radius range
analysis.size_comparison: Independent 64/216 trajectories at identical T and V per atom; compare structural and pressure block statistics, use 512 if size trends exceed uncertainty
analysis.future_density: Validated NPT or NVT pressure-versus-volume root search
analysis.future_diffusion: Longer size-checked trajectories, independent seeds, linear MSD regime and thermostat sensitivity/NVE checks

data.selection: Cover low/high T, compressed/expanded cells, different order, strains and failure precursors; DFT-label fixed geometries without relaxation
data.small_box_rule: Generate separate 64-atom periodic trajectories for low-cost labels; do not cut a 64-atom sub-box out of 216 atoms and assume unchanged boundaries
data.large_cell_rule: Replication provides an initialization or periodicity check, not independent configurations or a finite-size validation
data.source_group_rule: Group shared initial MD snapshots, continuations, heating/cooling descendants and scaled siblings together before train/validation/test splitting
data.independence: Frame spacing is storage cadence, not a proof of statistical independence
